name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.9, "3.10", "3.11", "3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          version: "0.2.26"
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv pip install --system pytest pytest-cookies
          uv pip install --system -e .

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest tests/

  test-generated-project:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        db: [tortoise, beanie]
        docker: [true, false]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          version: "0.2.26"
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Generate project
        run: |
          uv pip install --system cookiecutter
          cookiecutter --no-input . db=${{ matrix.db }} use_docker=${{ matrix.docker }} project_name="Test Project"

      - name: Validate generated project
        run: |
          cd test-project
          
          # Check file structure
          find . -type f -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./__pycache__/*" | head -20
          
          # Check Python syntax
          find . -name '*.py' -exec python -m py_compile {} +
          
          # Check for unreplaced template variables
          grep -r "{{cookiecutter" . || echo "No unreplaced template variables found"
          
          # Install dependencies with uv
          uv sync --system --frozen || echo "Dependency installation failed (expected for some cases)"
          
          # Test basic imports
          python -c "import app; print('Basic import successful')"

          version: "0.2.26"
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Generate project

          uv pip install --system cookiecutter

      - name: Validate generated project

          cd test-project
          
          # Check file structure
          find . -type f -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./__pycache__/*" | head -20

          # Check for unreplaced template variables
          grep -r "{{cookiecutter" . || echo "No unreplaced template variables found"
          
          # Install dependencies with uv
          uv sync --system --frozen || echo "Dependency installation failed (expected for some cases)"
